newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 25.

text.p: Furukawa Co Ltd and Nissho Iwai Corp to buy an idle Australian copper smelter from natural resources developer RTZ-CRA.

MANILA - Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto invites Chinese President Jiang Zemin to visit to Japan next year, the 25th anniversary of the resumption of diplomatic relations between the countries.
